decisions.reason: As a small accessory with lower sunk investment and less strategic importance than full trailer lines, it is the easiest offering to discontinue if results are underwhelming.
This multi-model box car trailer series was promoted on the home page and sits close to the firm's core business, so public commitment and investment make management likely to persist with it.

The car transporter trailer line likely required meaningful development and still fits the firm's target customers, so management would tend to continue and attribute any weak performance to temporary factors.
The low-bed trailer series is a prominently presented core hauling product, and sunk costs plus visible commitment favor staying the course.
The high trailer cover series complements the firm's established trailer range and was publicly highlighted, which makes withdrawal less likely under escalation of commitment.
As another home-page-promoted box car trailer series with several models, it reflects substantial commitment that management is likely to defend by keeping it on the market.
